description_en: Describes the CDN interaction rule configurations for a specified domain name
description_zh: 此API用于查询指定域名下的CDN联动规则配置
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-cdn-linkage-rules --resource-group-id default --domain example.aliyundoc.com --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCdnLinkageRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS instance belongs in Resource Management. If you leave this parameter empty, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: ddos高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组id。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of your website.

> The domain name must be added to your Anti-DDoS instance. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return for a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页包含的记录数量
parameters.name: page_size
